title: Big Data Availability and Asymmetric Voluntary Disclosures
near_miss_reason: Stacked design in every reported column: all regressions run on a cohort-stacked firm-year panel (each firm-year duplicated once per release cohort) with cohort-by-firm and cohort-by-year fixed effects (Tables 3-8, Figure 1; the article describes the design as stacked difference-in-differences). Most columns are Poisson (ppmlhdfe); even-numbered columns add 13 lagged time-varying firm controls; Table 4 Panel A adds a not-yet-released indicator (extra treatment regressor) and Panel B uses entropy-balancing weights; Table 7 adds subgroup-by-treatment interactions. Staggered binary design: satellite-data release at firm-specific years (7 cohorts 2011-2017, 117 treated and 526 never-treated firms); the stacked panel is shipped with pseudonymized firm ids.
eligible_reason: The underlying design qualifies (binary satellite-data release switching on at firm-specific years, 7 release cohorts 2011-2017, 117 treated firms, 526 never-treated firms, firm-year panel 2008-2018), but every reported specification is estimated on a cohort-STACKED panel (Data_T2_T3_T4_T5_T6_T7_T8_F1.dta: each firm-year duplicated once per cohort, 7 copies for 5,078 of 5,515 firm-years) with cohort-by-firm (pseudocohortgvkey) and cohort-by-year (cohortyear) fixed effects, and most columns are Poisson (ppmlhdfe). The OLS columns (Table 3 cols 3-4; Table 8 Panel A) are also stacked. Stacked DiD is excluded by PROTOCOL.md Section 2, so no reported specification is eligible. The exclusion is the estimator structure, not controls, so near_miss is false. An unstacked firm-year TWFE could be reconstructed from the shipped data (outcome and control values are identical across duplicated firm-year rows; event year = cohort year in which stacktreat==1), but the paper does not report such a specification.
design_notes: Treatment: release of satellite parking-lot traffic data (Orbital Insight / RS Metrics) for retailer i in year eventyear(i), 2011-2017 (Data_T1PB.dta eventyear distribution 2011:5, 2012:10, 2013:10, 2014:8, 2015:17, 2016:57, 2017:10). Panel: firm-years 2008-2018, 643 firms (117 ever treated, 526 never treated), pseudonymized gvkeys. Stacked variables (README): stacktreat = treated firm in cohort c; stackpost = year >= release year of cohort c; stacktreatpost = product; stackbet = data collection started but not yet released; stacktpm3..stacktpaf3 = relative-time bins (-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,>=3) for Figure 1; stacktreatpost1/2/3 = binned [-2,-1],[0,1],[2,+) for Table 4A; treated_ever = firm ever treated (not-yet-treated firms appear as controls in earlier cohorts: 4,728 rows with treated_ever==1 & stacktreat==0). Globals (Code_All.do lines 304-307): absorbc = pseudocohortgvkey cohortyear; cluster = pseudogvkey year (two-way); controls = 13 lagged time-varying firm controls (retvol_m_lag1 abs_ch_eps_prc bh_mktadjret_m_lag1 xrd_aky_lag1 lnme_aky_lag1 avg_numest_lag1 ior_lag1 dummy_issue mb_aky_lag1 blev_aky_lag1 std_eps_prc_lag1 sign_ch_eps_prc optimism_lag1). Odd columns omit controls, even columns include them. Table 4 Panel B restricts to treated_ever==1 (not-yet-treated controls) and uses entropy-balancing pweights (ebalance). Table 7 adds triple interactions with high-institutional-ownership / cash-flow-volatility / litigation-risk indicators.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Release years 2011-2017 (one cohort per year); verified from Data_T1PB.dta and from stacktreat/stackpost in the stacked panel.
modern_estimator_note: Cites Baker, Larcker and Wang (2022) per full-text flags; the remedy adopted is cohort stacking, no CSA/BJS/SA/dCDH estimates in the code.

priority_note: Not eligible as reported (stacked-only). If the lead decides to admit reconstructed unstacked TWFE versions, the shipped stacked panel can be collapsed to a 643-firm x 11-year panel (5,515 firm-years) with release year inferred from stacktreat/stackpost.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Regression list in data/packages/mnsc.2023.00816_regressions.txt captured only one command; all commands were read directly from Code_All.do (703 lines). Verified with pandas: 7 cohorts x 643 firms; rows per firm-year = 7 for 5,078 firm-years and 1 for 437; outcome and control values identical across duplicated rows. Clustering is two-way by pseudogvkey and year.
hand_check_nov4: Near-miss (stacked-only; most columns Poisson; controls in even columns). The screener set near_miss false because the exclusion was 'estimator structure, not controls', but the PROTOCOL coding rule lists stacked-only staggered designs as near-misses. Article text confirms the stacked DiD design throughout. Not controls-only.
